rows.grounds: locative of ḍolahasta, denoting the swinging-hand posture
compound of madhyastha, aṅgula, and agra indicating the tip of the middle finger

items.question: Which specific point serves as the designated marker in the swinging-hand posture?
premises: The verse addresses the ḍolahasta or swinging-hand posture.
It identifies the tip of the middle finger as the relevant point.
This identification is presented as especially emphasized.
items.inference: In the swinging-hand posture, the tip of the middle finger is the specifically designated point of reference.
uncertainties: The exact spatial function of this fingertip marker is not fully stated within this verse alone.
items.plain_english: In the swinging-hand posture, however, the tip of the middle finger is especially the point of reference.
